tests.title: Register a new user
tests.steps: Enter valid email and password, submit registration form.

tests.title: Log in with existing account
tests.steps: Enter valid email and password, submit login form.

tests.title: Invalid login attempt
tests.steps: Enter invalid email and password, submit login form.
tests.expected_result: Login failed due to invalid credentials

tests.title: Browse products
tests.steps: Navigate to product list, select a product.

tests.title: Search for products
tests.steps: Enter valid search query, submit search form.

tests.requirement: Search returns empty result for invalid query
tests.title: Invalid search query
tests.steps: Enter invalid search query, submit search form.

tests.title: View product details
tests.steps: Navigate to product page, view details.

tests.requirement: User can add product to cart
tests.title: Add product to cart
tests.preconditions: Product exists and user has a cart
tests.steps: Select product, click 'Add to Cart'.

tests.title: Update cart quantity
tests.preconditions: User has a cart with products
tests.steps: Select product, adjust quantity, submit.

tests.requirement: User can remove product from cart
tests.title: Remove product from cart
tests.preconditions: User has a cart with products
tests.steps: Select product, click 'Remove'.

tests.title: Proceed to checkout
tests.preconditions: User has a cart with products
tests.steps: Click 'Checkout', select shipping address.

tests.title: Invalid shipping address
tests.preconditions: User has a cart with products
tests.steps: Enter invalid shipping address, submit.

tests.title: Make payment
tests.preconditions: User has a cart with products and valid payment method
tests.steps: Select payment method, submit payment.

tests.title: Order confirmed
tests.preconditions: User has a cart with products and valid payment method
tests.steps: Submit order, confirm order details.

tests.title: View order history
tests.steps: Navigate to order history, view orders.

tests.title: Log out
tests.steps: Click 'Log out', confirm logout.

tests.title: Register with existing email
tests.steps: Enter existing email, submit registration form.
tests.expected_result: Registration failed due to duplicate email

tests.title: Log in with invalid password
tests.steps: Enter valid email, invalid password, submit login form.
tests.expected_result: Login failed due to invalid credentials

tests.title: Browse products with no results
tests.steps: Navigate to product list, select a product.

tests.title: Search for products with no results
tests.steps: Enter valid search query, submit search form.

tests.title: View non-existent product
tests.steps: Navigate to product page, view details.

tests.requirement: User can add product to cart
tests.title: Add non-existent product to cart
tests.steps: Select product, click 'Add to Cart'.

tests.title: Update non-existent product quantity
tests.preconditions: Product does not exist in cart
tests.steps: Select product, adjust quantity, submit.

tests.requirement: User can remove product from cart
tests.title: Remove non-existent product from cart
tests.preconditions: Product does not exist in cart
tests.steps: Select product, click 'Remove'.
